seed10_selection_independent_of_clearanc.criterion: Minimum absolute SF failure-time difference from cohort median; smallest seed resolves ties

visual_encoding.layout: Two aligned 5-row by 10-column grids in natural seed order; row=seed//10, col=seed%10
visual_encoding.filled_marker: The precisely specified geometric event occurred at least once in the trial
visual_encoding.empty_marker: The specified event was not observed; this does not mean the trial reached the goal
visual_encoding.event_definition: At actual pose k choose nearest obstacle j. Over its recorded solver-success step, d_j increases and d_j(next)>=0.05 mm, while min_i d_i(next)<0.05 mm
visual_encoding.avoid_label: No chance probability, primitive feature, planner infeasibility, or causal claim is encoded
